# Local document extraction

Generated by scripts/sync-knowledge-vendors.mjs from installed packages.

- pdfjs-dist 6.4.299: Mozilla PDF.js, Apache-2.0. Source: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
- fflate 0.8.3: MIT. Source: https://github.com/101arrowz/fflate

Retain bundled licenses and font/CMap/WASM notices. The browser loads the PDF module and worker with the same package version. Documents and images are read locally; no document is sent to an external recognition service. OCR uses the separate local vendor/ocr assets.
